style: Premium miniature stop-motion set photography in the manner of a Laika or Wes Anderson miniature set shot for a high-end commercial: handcrafted matte clay, wool felt, painted wood and small brushed-brass details; tactile real-world miniature textures; macro lens with shallow depth of field (about f/4); subtle film grain. Refined, calm, elegant and adult; never childish, never cartoonish, no glossy plastic, no neon.
light: Soft studio key light from the upper left, warm bounce fill, gentle soft shadows; the lighting direction is identical across the whole series.
palette: warm cream #F1ECE2 walls and floors, cobalt blue #2B3BCF for his things, soft coral #F08C8C for her things, lilac #B8B2EA accents, ink #232024 details, brushed brass #B08D57 hardware.
characters: The people are premium 3D animated characters with adult proportions (about 7 heads tall), a fashion-editorial look like a high-end Apple or IKEA motion commercial, matte clay-like skin with subtle subsurface scattering, natural-sized eyes (never oversized), real fabric materials, calm and graceful body language.
groom: the groom: a Korean man about 30, short neat black hair with a soft side part, black rectangular glasses, slim build, calm friendly smile
bride: the bride: a Korean woman about 30, chin-length black bob with see-through bangs, small pearl earrings, gentle smile

daily.groom: a cobalt-navy fine-knit sweater over a white collared shirt, light warm grey trousers, brown leather loafers
daily.bride: a soft coral knit cardigan over a cream blouse, a flowing cream midi skirt, ballet flats

wedding.groom: a black tuxedo with satin lapels and a black bow tie
wedding.bride: a white off-shoulder lace wedding gown, hair tucked with a small pearl pin

casual.groom: a light blue cardigan over a white t-shirt, cream trousers, white sneakers
casual.bride: a white summer dress and a short sheer veil

avoid: text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, chibi proportions, big cartoon eyes, plastic sheen, neon, clutter, extra people

items.prompt: Character turnaround sheet of the groom: the same character three times side by side on one sheet (front view, three-quarter view, side view), full body head to toe, neutral relaxed standing pose. Plain flat light warm grey studio background (#E6E2DA), soft even studio light, evenly spaced at the same scale, no labels.

Character turnaround sheet of the bride: the same character three times side by side on one sheet (front view, three-quarter view, side view), full body head to toe, neutral relaxed standing pose. Plain flat light warm grey studio background (#E6E2DA), soft even studio light, evenly spaced at the same scale, no labels.

Cross-section of a two-room miniature dollhouse standing on a large cream studio tabletop: we see the front edge of the table, the outer walls and the pitched roof line, so it clearly reads as a miniature set on a table. The left room is his, the home study of a meticulous purchasing manager who keeps everything in order: a cobalt-blue painted wall, a straight-lined walnut desk with a squared stack of documents in a wire tray, a calculator, a desk planner and pens lined up in a holder; shelves of identical cobalt binders with tidy coloured index tabs, storage boxes in a perfect grid, and a small wall board with sticky notes aligned in neat rows; a brass desk lamp; the groom sits at the desk writing. The right room is hers, the warm room of a psychological counselor: a soft coral wall, two comfortable armchairs facing each other across a small round side table with a box of tissues, a teapot with two cups and an open notebook, a shelf of books, many plants in ceramic pots and a hanging vine, a warm floor lamp; the bride waters a plant. A single cream partition wall separates the two rooms. Both characters have natural adult proportions; her head is slightly smaller than his. Camera straight-on and slightly elevated, the whole house centered with breathing room; the upper third is calm empty studio backdrop for typography. Daytime.

Macro still life on the cream tabletop: a cobalt ceramic cup of black coffee on the left and a coral ceramic cup of milk on the right, side by side with a small gap, shallow depth of field, calm empty upper third for typography.

Macro still life on the cream tabletop: on the left a perfectly straight brushed-brass ruler lying flat, on the right a curling green vine with small leaves growing from a tiny coral pot; balanced mirror-like composition, shallow depth of field, calm empty upper third for typography.
Macro still life on the cream tabletop: a crisp cobalt clay cube on the left and a soft coral clay sphere on the right, side by side, shallow depth of field, calm empty upper third for typography.

Macro still life on the cream tabletop: a small matte ceramic sun in warm coral on the left and a matte ceramic crescent moon in cobalt on the right, each standing on a little brass stand, shallow depth of field, calm empty upper third for typography.

Close shot of the cream partition wall inside the miniature dollhouse, seen in cross-section: the groom leans his back against the wall in his cobalt room on the left, the bride leans her back against the same wall in her coral room on the right. They cannot see each other; both smile softly with eyes half closed. Medium shot from the waist up, the wall exactly in the center, calm empty upper third for typography. Late afternoon light.

His room in the miniature dollhouse (cobalt wall, tidy walnut desk, shelves, brass desk lamp), daytime. The groom stands by his desk and raises one open hand toward the camera as if gently saying 'wait a second', pushing his glasses up with the other hand. Medium-wide shot; he stands in the right half; the left half and the upper third are calm empty cobalt wall for typography.

Her room in the miniature dollhouse (soft coral wall, curved furniture, plants), daytime. A gallery wall of small picture frames with simple abstract paintings, all hanging charmingly crooked; the bride stands on tiptoe adjusting one frame and, amused, tilts it even more. Medium-wide shot; she is in the right third; the left third is calm wall for typography.

Close shot of a neat walnut shelf in his cobalt room: a perfectly aligned row of seven identical cobalt ceramic mugs, all handles facing right, and one coral mug in the middle turned the other way. Shallow depth of field, calm empty upper third for typography. No people.

Miniature street at dusk: the facade of a small apartment building with a grid of warm-lit windows. In every window a small simple dark silhouette figure is turned toward the same direction: toward one coral-lit window on the right where a woman's silhouette sits reading a book, unbothered. Straight-on view, calm empty dusk sky in the upper third for typography.

Macro still life on a walnut desk: two vintage horseshoe magnets lying apart with a clear gap, poles facing each other: the left one cobalt enamel with brushed-brass tips, the right one coral enamel with brushed-brass tips. Shallow depth of field, calm empty upper third for typography.

Seen from his cobalt room through an open doorway: the cobalt-painted door frame fills the left and right foreground edges, softly out of focus. In the middle ground, in her warm sunlit counseling room, the bride stands full body, head to toe, smiling gently, holding a notebook to her chest beside two soft armchairs that face each other across a small round table with a box of tissues and a teapot with two cups; shelves of books, plants, a warm floor lamp and a calm painting on the soft coral wall. Natural adult proportions. She stands slightly right of center; calm wall area on the upper left for typography.

The couple's miniature house at night, whole and natural, seen from a little below on a gentle hillside above a moonlit lake: a charming two-story stone cottage with a slate roof sitting properly on its walls (nothing lifted, floating or cut away), two chimneys, lilac wisteria and climbing roses on the walls, small lanterns by the door; on the upper floor two windows glow warmly side by side, the left one with cobalt-blue curtains (his room) and the right one with soft coral curtains (her room); cypress trees and distant village lights reflected in the lake. Above, a deep periwinkle night sky with soft stars and two brighter stars close together. The house sits in the lower half, slightly right of center; the upper left is calm sky for typography. No people.

Miniature kitchen in the dollhouse at night, closer: a wall-mounted TV (16:9) facing the camera fills about 62 percent of the frame width, centered in the upper two thirds; below it, along the bottom edge, a round cream table with a small cake with two lit candles and a bouquet of lilac and white flowers; warm cozy light; a sliver of kitchen shelves and a dark window at the sides. Exterior of the dollhouse at night seen from the street: one tall coral-lit window glows warmly, and behind its sheer curtain the bride's soft silhouette stands looking out. Everything else is deep blue night. The window sits center-left; calm dark area on the right for typography.

Macro on a cream table at night under a warm lamp: two large jigsaw puzzle pieces, one cobalt and one coral, that clearly do not fit together, slightly apart and tilted. Shallow depth of field, calm empty upper third.

His bedside at night, macro close-up: an iPhone 14 Pro (gold, thin even bezels, Dynamic Island) standing upright in a small walnut stand on the nightstand, its screen facing the camera and filling about 72 percent of the frame height, slightly right of center; a brass lamp glow and a glass of water softly out of focus on the left; the edge of cobalt bed linen. Calm area in the left third for typography. No people.

On his walnut nightstand at night: a sculptural heart-shaped lamp made of brushed brass and frosted glass, glowing softly warm from inside; dark cobalt room behind; shallow depth of field; centered with calm space above.

Front cross-section of the miniature dollhouse at night, both rooms lamp-lit: the groom in his cobalt room on the left and the bride in her coral room on the right, each standing close to the cream partition wall between them with one hand resting on it, facing the wall. Medium-wide, the wall centered, calm upper third for typography.

One bright merged room in the dollhouse in the morning (the partition wall is gone; the left half keeps his cobalt accents, the right half her coral accents, blended with lilac): in the middle two different chairs face each other, a plump black velvet armchair on the left and a simple white wooden chair on the right, with soft beams of morning light from a tall window. Wide, calm, solemn; the upper third empty. No people.

Exterior of the finished miniature dollhouse at golden hour, standing on the cream tabletop: a charming two-story house with a small balcony on the upper floor, two tall windows, climbing coral roses; warm golden light. The house sits in the lower half; soft warm sky in the upper half for typography. No people.

A miniature garden at golden hour: lush round pastel trees and a small lilac-painted bench on the lawn. The groom kneels on one knee offering a bouquet of pink roses to the bride, who sits on the bench and smiles with her hands at her cheeks. Side view, full bodies, centered in the lower half; the upper third is soft trees and sky for typography.

Her coral room in golden afternoon light, close shot: a cream wooden picture frame (portrait, 3:4) standing on a small writing desk by the window, facing the camera and filling about 72 percent of the frame height, centered; a vase of coral tulips beside it, softly out of focus. A calm strip at the top for typography. No people.

A cork pinboard on her coral wall in warm light, mostly empty with a few brass pins, a sprig of dried flowers and a coral ribbon in one corner; straight-on, the board fills most of the frame with a thin wooden border. No people, no photos on it.

A miniature wedding aisle at golden hour: cream chairs on both sides decorated with lilac and white flowers, petals on a cream runner, a floral arch at the end with the soft sun behind it. The groom and the bride walk hand in hand down the aisle toward the arch, seen from behind. Camera low at the start of the aisle, symmetrical; the arch and sky in the upper third.
